facts.fact: Cabinet approved a National Data Protection Policy, approved the repeal of the Right to Access Information Commission Act and authorised enactment of a new Data Protection and Right to Access Information Act, with the Ministry of Information and Civic Education and the Attorney-General's office to finalise and table the Bill in Parliament; announced by the Information Minister on 21 April 2026.
